notes.title: v0.3.5.1 - Performance improvements, exploding trees, bug fixes
notes.notes:
[h1]Here's what's new this week:[/h1]

[list]
  [*]Performance improvements for the "Normal" and "High" graphics quality settings.  More improvements still to come, of course.  If performance hasn't been great for you, we're very interested to hear how it is now. [h1][b]IMPORTANT: If you were already on "Normal" or "High," you'll need to toggle to another graphics quality setting and then back in order for the new performance improvements to take effect.[/b][/h1]
  [*]Trees and rocks can now be damaged (and exploded) by bullets.
  [*]Rocks can now be harvested.
  [*]Fixed trees and rocks and grass shifting around after harvesting terrain.
  [*]Clicking New Simulation in the main menu no longer drops you to the desktop.
  [*]Fixed intro video not fullscreen for first-time players.
  [*]Fixed quantum distortion harvesting effect stops working after a while.
  [*]Fixed randomly being shifted into the planet or underwater from time to time.
  [*]Fixed a potential error when changing graphics quality settings that was preventing the settings from being applied.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.3.0.7 - Intro video and music by OVERWERK
notes.notes:
The latest build is up, and it's got a brand new intro video (rendered in real time). Also, we are excited to announce that Metaverse's soundtrack is now by OVERWERK.

Not to mention all the new stuff we just added in 0.3.0.6:
[list]
  [*]Big terrain improvements. We think it’s gorgeous and can't wait for you to see it.
  [*]All new water system. Planets now have ponds, lakes, oceans, and continents.
  [*]Completely procedural, unique, spherical planets. Actually, this has been the case since the beginning, but now that we have continents, it’s worth pointing out again!
  [*]All new UI and experience for crafting. Access the LAIR systems while out in the field.
  [*]All new and greatly improved B.I.T.s for building your base.
  [*]New gear management system.
  [*]Double-click to transfer items between backpack and LAIR.
  [*]Tweaked amounts of refined materials extracted from raw materials. Stuff is easier to get now.
  [*]Increased player speed.
  [*]Drones are easier to kill (but as a consolation to the drones, their ammo hurts more now).
  [*]Performance tweaks and improvements.
  [*]Doubled draw distance.
  [*]Lots of other improvements and fixes.
[/list]


Check it out and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Version 0.2.0.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
  [*]Brand new main menu screen.
  [*]Proper input, audio, and video configuration screens.
  [*]Multiplayer is now open to everyone (accessible via the Embarcation level).
  [*]New terrain system with much better mountains, etc.  Every player has a unique planet.
  [*]Snow on the tops of mountains that go high enough.
  [*]Really far draw distance.
  [*]More realistic lighting in the world.
  [*]Lots of grass.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes and improvements[/h1]
[list]
  [*]Fixed a scenario in multiplayer where the planet might not load.
  [*]Fixed stairs not working.
  [*]Slightly boosted jump height and horizontal movement while in the air.
  [*]Frame rate and performance optimizations.
  [*]It’s no longer possible to fall through any gaps in the LAIR.
  [*]Fixed terrain and B.I.T.s sometimes not loading correctly near quantum beacons.
  [*]Drones no longer follow the player to the LAIR.
  [*]New resource icons.
  [*]Tutorial is more forgiving now, hopefully relieving pain points where some players were getting stuck.
  [*]…and lots of other smaller improvements and fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.1.0.7 (Drone Combat, Quantum Beacons + much more)
notes.notes:
[h1]Features & Improvements[/h1]
[list]
  [*]Added drone combat!
  [*]Pistol now fires projectiles instead of a laser, and projectiles all have tracers.
  [*]Quantum Beacons can now be researched and fabricated.  Use them to teleport from your LAIR to specific locations in the world.  Pick up blown up drone parts in order to be able to build Quantum Beacons.
  [*]New crosshair.
  [*]Added gun recoil.
  [*]Refined the amount of refined materials you get by refining, to make it easier to fabricate many types of materials (Bronze, Tin, Steel, etc).
  [*]Reduced day/night cycle to 60 minutes IRL.
  [*]A bunch of new sounds and music.
  [*]Removed grass meshes for now, for much improved FPS on low-mid range machines.
  [*]Removed that annoying running-breathing sound.
  [*]Improved the way pistol and player react to lighting.
  [*]Tweaked nighttime lighting.
  [*]New loading screen that shows Early Access progress.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
  [*]Fixed Corban sometimes not sticking with player, which meant Snapback took too long.
  [*]Fixed doors in the LAIR where you could walk through and end up outside the level.
  [*]Fixed sometimes being able to see metavar’s head if you look up and jump.
  [*]Fixed time not passing while inside LAIR.
  [*]Fixed clay door placement (just realized that other doors might need fixing — will adjust that soon).
  [*]Fixed a bug that could cause Extraction station to lock up.
  [*]Fixed player bouncing when entering the LAIR elevator platform.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.1.0.0 is here, and it's a big one!
notes.notes:
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
  [*]New LAIR stations to research and fabricate B.I.T.s, which are pre-built blocks that can be used to build structures out in the world.
  [*]Caves!!

  [*]Cubic is now 64 bit, which translates to increased performance.
  [*]Improved shadowing, and made underground areas actually dark.
  [*]Added a flashlight (press V to toggle)
  [*]Added clouds.
  [*]Increased draw distance.
  [*]Grass and trees are now always shown as far as the eye can see wherever the terrain has been drawn.
  [*]Increased walk/run speed.
  [*]Added sounds for elevator buttons.
  [*]Tons of little tweaks and improvements.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
  [*]Jazz hands came back, so we swatted them away again.
  [*]Sun flare no longer visible before eyelids open during intro.
[/list]

[h1][i]Warning[/i][/h1]
  [*][i]This update will clear your backpack and lair inventory.  When you start playing with it though, you’ll see that it was totally worth it![/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/325430/extras/collisionChanges.png[/img]

With this update, you can now disintegrate placed fabrications.  The amount of damage a fabrication can take is dependent on the [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hardnesses_of_the_elements_(data_page)]hardness[/url] and quantity of the materials used in it.

There are also a few other important changes, such as improved collision detection on placed fabrications (this one's for you, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/325430/discussions/0/619569608657394734/]Bilbo[/url])

[list]
    [*]Fabrications can now be disintegrated with your laser pistol.
[/list]

[list]
    [*]Significantly improved colliders on fabricated objects.
    [*]Improved debug logging when a schematic can’t be imported.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed "View in Steam Workshop" and Steam user Workshop page links not working in Information Exchange.
    [*]Fixed a bug that could cause frame rate to slow down after some types of fabrications were placed.
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fabrications placed before this update cannot be destroyed.  This will be fixed in the next update.
[/list]

notes.title: The Information Exchange Update (0.0.3.3)
notes.notes:
[h1][b]No tricks, just a treat! [/b][/h1]
Today we're releasing our third major update, and with it,  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=325430] Steam Workshop [/url]  support, through the new Information Exchange feature! 

Even in this initial version, we made sure that workshop support is completely integrated into the Cubic Metaware, which means that you can browse and download other player's shared fabrication schematics entirely from within Cubic. 

Just check out the new browse tab on your Fabrication Station. Don't worry though, if it's your thing, you can still use the standard steam workshop web experience to browse and rate your fellow contributor's schematics. 

This is just a first step, among many, that we will be taking to more deeply connect our community to each other and to us. Still, we are really excited for the potential momentum around collaborative construction and iteration of fabrications within just this first version of the feature. 

 
[h1][b]To get things kicked off, we wanted to have a fun little pumpkin carving contest![/b][/h1]
We've gone ahead and uploaded a generic pumpkin schematic that you can download in-game and customize however you like. Three winners will be picked, based on a combination of votes from the community and an interpreted amount of originality (since derivation is likely to occur). [i]Deadline for submissions is November 1st, 10am PST.[/i]

[b] - 1st Place[/b] - Will receive an Investors key to upgrade their account as well as a Cubic 4-pack to share with their friends. 

[b] - 2nd Place[/b] - Will receive an Investors key and another copy of Cubic to share. 

[b] - 3rd Place[/b] - Will receive an Investors key and a well intentioned but still imagined ethereal high-five. 
 
Good luck, and have fun to all who take a "stab" at the contest! 


[h1][b]One to many:[/b][/h1]
Finally, since this is the very first step for Cubic in to a community of interconnectedness, let's focus on being a community known for being excellent to one another, from the very beginning through to the hopefully very distant end! 

As always please report any bugs or feature requests that pop up and we'll get them added to the development list.


[h1][b]------------ FULL CHANGE LOG ------------[/b][/h1]

[h1][b]Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Publish and download Fabricator schematics via the new Information Exchange.
[/list]
[h1][b]Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Made Fabricator text much more readable.
[*]Made Fabricator camera save its position when a schematic is saved.
[*]Now auto-synthesizing colors when fabricating if enough materials are in storage.
[/list]
[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Moved save game files on Mac to a much safer location.
[/list]

Finally, since this is the very first step for Cubic in to a community of interconnectedness, let's focus on being a community known for being excellent to one another, from the very beginning through to the hopefully very distant end! 

As always please report any bugs or feature requests that pop up and we'll get them added to the development list.


[h1][b]------------ FULL CHANGE LOG ------------[/b][/h1]

[h1][b]Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Publish and download Fabricator schematics via the new Information Exchange.
[/list]
[h1][b]Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Made Fabricator text much more readable.
[*]Made Fabricator camera save its position when a schematic is saved.
[*]Now auto-synthesizing colors when fabricating if enough materials are in storage.
[/list]
[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Moved save game files on Mac to a much safer location.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.0.3.1 Available Now!
notes.notes:
Our last update, version 0.0.3.0 introduced some really cool new features in the Fabricator.  Unfortunately, only a few people got to enjoy them because in our excitement to bring you those new features, we neglected to fully regression test some parts of the game, which left some things broken for many people.  We're truly sorry for that, and will do our very best to make sure that doesn't happen again. And as always, if you do experience bugs, or if you have feedback (good or bad), we encourage you to comment in the forums or email us at support@cubicdevice.com.  So without further ado, here's what's new:

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed Fabricator portion of tutorial being completely broken and impassable.
[*]Fixed LAIR floor turning to quicksand while player is in Fabricator.
[*]Fixed door placement part of tutorial being broken.
[*]Fixed fabrications not made out of plastic could not be placed in world.
[*]Fixed being unable to fabricate an object that contains plain uncolored plastic.
[*]Fixed player view getting stuck in the fully zoomed in mode during teleport if they were in the LAIR before the delivery orb sequence starts.
[*]Fixed crash bug on Mac that prevented us from releasing 0.0.3.0 on Mac.[/list]

And of course, all the awesome new features we added in 0.0.3.0:

[url=http://www.cubicdevice.com/images/update_graphics/0.0.3.0.png][img]http://www.cubicdevice.com/images/update_graphics/0.0.3.0.png[/img][/url]

[b]FABRICATION STATION UPGRADE[/b]
Not only has the fabricator resources view been completely rewritten,
it also has a new Combinator module for the synthesis of synthetic
building materials. Don't know if you should be excited about that
or not? The best way to describe the new Combinator module is to
think of crafting, but on a molecular level.
 
[b]1300Kg OF PRE-SYNTHESIZED PLASTIC, DELIVERED TO YOUR DOOR[/b]
And just so you can start building right away, a delivery orb has 
been dispatched with a collection of raw plastic polymers.
 
[b]FOUR PIGMENTS, 10,000,000 POSSIBILITIES[/b]
If you're thinking, "playing with grey plastic doesn't sound very fun," 
we agree. That's why we've also included some pre-processed pigments
for you to use with the raw plastic polymer in the new Colorizer module
of the Fabricator.
 
[b]FOUR NEW FORMULAS FOR THE COMBINATOR[/b]
To make sure the plastic party never has to end,
 we are including the formula for a highly durable, 
heat resistant polymer plastic. Plus the formulas 
for the four base pigments mentioned earlier.
 
[b]POWERED UP[/b]
Two power cells just aren't enough these days.  And since 
they are Quantum Technology, they aren't fabricatable yet. 
So we threw in one of these as well, just in case.  That, or 
you'll definitely want one for what's coming in the next update... 
 
[b]FULL CHANGE-LOG:[/b]
[list]
[*]New Fabrication Station holographic UI
[*]New Plastic Polymer formula
[*]New base Pigment formulas
[*]New Colorizer module
[*]New Combinator Module
[*]New Synthetics Module
    [*]Added Corban’s voice during Fabricator portion of tutorial instead of just using subtitles.
    [*]Fixed Corban looking in the wrong direction during tutorial at the Fabrication Station.
    [*]Fixed loader’s clicking/beeping sound potentially persisting past loader.
    [*]Fixed typo (Presss E) when touching mission cube for the first time.
    [*]Fixed lair colors not fully red in Sandbox mode.
    [*]Fixed jumping from happening during tutorial before the Metavar has even stood up.
     [*]Fixed gravity in LAIR to match gravity of outside world.
    [*]Fixed infinite jump in LAIR.
    [*]Fixed flickering hands during tutorial (sorry, no more Jazz hands)
    [*]Made camera lock in place when viewing holographic UI panels (to prevent UI shimmering)
    [*]Fixed white screen of death.
[*]Distribution of refined elements when processing from raw source elements is now based on real world element abundance.
   [*]Fixed camera rotation getting messed up if you’re not looking straight ahead when Corban docks for the very first time.
   [*]Fixed Corban not docking when Snapback is activated, which meant he was having to travel by himself in realtime back to the LAIR.
